header: You both get a free month per referral
lead: €39 for you and €39 for the shop you referred. We credit it on the next invoice once their first till is in use.
note: The full conditions are on the programme page. You can earn up to 12 credits a year.

steps.title: You send the link
steps.text: You send it from your account, with your name on it. We never contact anyone on our own.

steps.title: They sign up
steps.text: Trial, setup, then their first till goes live. They choose how long that takes.

steps.title: You both get the credit
steps.text: It appears on the next invoice, with nothing to claim. If you're still in your trial, it appears on your first invoice.
